episodes.title: Blood Bath
episodes.summary: Thirty years ago, a newlywed couple were murdered at the Cold River Motel in a satanic ritual; a group of true crime enthusiasts have been invited to the motel's reopening, where they discover history might be repeating itself.

episodes.title: Night Orchid
episodes.summary: Trapped by the raging storm and unable to call for help, the guests retreat to their rooms, uncertain who among them is the killer; two strangers seeking shelter hide their true identities from the others.

episodes.title: Mirror Moves
episodes.summary: Fear and paranoia drive some of the guests to take part in something unspeakable.

episodes.title: Devil in the Details
episodes.summary: When the storm temporarily subsides, the guests attempt to leave the motel and find help. Others try to figure out who the other killer might be.

episodes.title: Jailbait
episodes.summary: The guests grow more suspicious when the driver that brought them there days earlier shows up at their doorstep. His presence causes a rift between the men and women, leading to a violent outburst with devastating consequences.

episodes.title: Guts and Glory
episodes.summary: Triggered by a gruesome discovery, one the surviving guests goes mad, haunted by his own traumatic past.

episodes.title: Cat and Mouse
episodes.summary: The surviving guests team up to stop a satanic ritual after discovering the true identities of the killers.

episodes.title: Grand Guignol
episodes.summary: Things culminate in a bloody finale at the premiere of a new film based on the Cold River Motel.
